## Why

2026-10-26: hand relays S125 and S127 stopped when Codex printed 'ERROR: Your workspace is out of credits. Add credits to continue.' (.scratch/s127/impl/out1.txt:4724, text mode). The codex adapter classifies only 'You've hit your usage limit' and 429 rate_limit_exceeded as limited (internal/agent/codex/codex.go:194), so in ork this would fail the run instead of falling back to the next lineup row (adj 156: fallback only on classified rate limits).
